capabilities: Highlight dictionary words automatically across vault notes
Show definitions for matching terms in Live Preview and Reading Mode
Add terms via a right-click "Add to Dictionary" command
Manage, search, edit and sort dictionary entries in a settings dashboard
Refresh the dictionary after manually editing the JSON storage file
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to automatically highlight custom terms across a vault and display their definitions without creating manual links.
summary: Personal dictionary plugin that automatically highlights words you define and shows their definitions in Live Preview and Reading Mode.
